name: @oxy.so/services
description: OxyHQ Expo/React Native SDK — UI components, screens, and native features
author: OxyHQ

scripts.build: bun run check:icon-fonts && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target commonjs && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target module && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target typescript && bun run copy-assets && bun run copy-dts && bun run delete-dts.js && bun run delete-debug-view
scripts.build:js: bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target commonjs && bun x react-native-builder-bob build --target module && bun run copy-assets
scripts.release: rm -rf lib && bun run build && release-it
scripts.prepublishOnly: node ../../scripts/assert-bun-publish.mjs && bun run typescript && bun run test && bun run build

//@oxy.so/bloom: RE-RAISE THIS FLOOR ON EVERY BREAKING BLOOM RELEASE, in the same commit as the root package.json catalog entry and the code that requires it. The breaking position is the MAJOR, so `^3.0.1` means `>=3.0.1 <4.0.0`: 3.x minors are admitted on semver's additive promise, and Bloom 4.0.0 is refused until someone raises this deliberately. The CAP is the part that is load-bearing. An earlier revision of this key recorded the opposite trade -- an uncapped `>=` floor, accepted so that intentionally-breaking Bloom 0.x minors would not be blocked -- and that trade is closed by evidence rather than by preference: an unbounded range is exactly what let `bun install` pair this package with Bloom 1.0.0 and emit no warning at all, and 1.0.0 broke it four ways (a deleted provider, a renamed confirm option, a renamed Chip fill, and two REMOVED SUBPATHS that fail at bundle time, before any typecheck runs). A floor is a claim about what was measured; a cap is the claim that nothing beyond it was. RAISED TO 3.0.1 from `^2.1.0`. Bloom 3.0.0 breaks exactly two things -- `PageHeader` defaults to `presentation="floating"` and stops hiding the title under `transparent`, and `Field disabled` now reaches the control that reads the field context -- and THIS PACKAGE IMPORTS NEITHER: it renders no `PageHeader` and no `Field`, and 3.0 removes no subpath (unlike 2.0.0, which is why that floor cost code changes and this one does not). Its six `transparent` occurrences are CSS colour values, not the PageHeader prop. The cap had to move rather than widen to a union, because leaving `^2.1.0` in place is what made `bun install` resolve a SECOND, nested Bloom 2.12.4 under this package for any app on Bloom 3 -- two copies of a library whose 3.0 contracts (`control-surface`, `TopEdgeProvider`, `ScrollOffsetProvider`) are React contexts, so a provider from one copy cannot be read by a consumer from the other. Mention's `oxyRuntimeCompatibility` test is what caught it; nothing in a typecheck can. RAISED AGAIN TO 3.2.0 from `^3.0.1`, for the same class of reason the 2.x note records, only in the other direction: 3.2.0 ADDS the per-glyph icon subpaths (`@oxy.so/bloom/icons/RiAtLine`) that this package's screens now import instead of the `@oxy.so/bloom/icons` barrel, and a missing subpath fails at bundle time, in the consumer's Metro, long after this package has typechecked and shipped. `^3.0.1` would have admitted Bloom 3.0.1 and 3.1.0, neither of which has those subpaths, so the floor is the only thing standing between a consumer and a red build. Nothing else about 3.1.0 or 3.2.0 is required here; the cap stays at the major. RAISED TO ^4.2.0: FollowButton now delegates its visuals to Bloom media-header FollowButton with loading, textStyle and large size; the new shared UI contracts require one Bloom4 context across Services and its consumer. RAISED TO ^4.31.0: the sign-in and account screens type one-time codes into `InputOtp` with `type="alphanumeric"` (the long sign-in code and backup codes), which 4.31.0 adds; older 4.x drops the letters. RAISED TO ^4.35.0: every password field passes `revealable` to `TextFieldInput` (the eye button, 4.35.0); older 4.x drops the prop silently and the password cannot be shown. The provider also mounts `@oxy.so/bloom/locale` (4.32.0+). RAISED TO ^5.1.0 (services 9.0.0, a major because consumers must move to Bloom 5 with it): Bloom 5.0.0 types `Card`'s `style` without radius, border width or `overflow` (geometry goes through `radius`/`border`/`clipContent`) and stops clipping a Card's children by default, so `BenefitList`'s `overflow: 'visible'` became both a type error and unnecessary; it is removed. The cap MOVES rather than widening to a `^4 || ^5` union, for the reason the 3.0.1 note records: a union lets an app resolve a second, nested Bloom copy and split the React contexts. The floor is 5.1.0 because that is the version measured here (every package builds and tests against it); 5.0.0 was not measured. RAISED TO ^6.0.0 (services 10.0.0, a major because consumers must move to Bloom 6 with it, and because this package's own `FollowButton`/`FollowTargetButton` `size` moves with Bloom's vocabulary): Bloom 6.0.0 removes the duplicate spellings its 5.x types still admitted, and this package used four of them. The control `size` narrows to `xs|sm|md|lg`, so every `small`/`medium`/`large` handed to a Bloom control became `sm`/`md`/`lg`, and the Follow buttons' public `size` became `sm|md|lg` because it is passed straight through to Bloom's media-header `FollowButton`. `Switch` is controlled by `checked`/`onCheckedChange`, not `value`/`onValueChange`. `Button` has no `variant`: each call site names `appearance` and `tone` (the pair the 5.x recipe resolved the variant to, so nothing repaints), `LinkButton`'s colour is `linkTone`, and `PeableButton` renders `InverseButton`. `Card` takes `appearance="outline"` for `variant="outlined"`. The deprecated spellings Bloom 6 still accepts (`isInvalid`, Chip `color`/`variant`) are not breaks and are left alone. The cap MOVES rather than widening to a `^5 || ^6` union, for the reason the 3.0.1 note records: a union lets an app resolve a second, nested Bloom copy and split the React contexts. The floor is 6.0.0 because that is the version measured when this raise was made; the workspace catalog has since moved to ^6.2.0, which adds only the `cover-header` subpath this package does not import, so the floor stays. MAINTENANCE 6.2.1: floor >=6.2.1 and cap <6.3.0 deliberately admit only the reviewed patch line with native Back/X completion and SVG paint/resize fixes. Known 6.4.0 lacks these fixes; the exact root catalog pin prevents a caret from selecting it. A broader minor range requires forward-port and consumer acceptance. VERIFIED 7.1.2: the additional >=7.1.2 <7.2.0 line contains the reviewed native fixes. Services build/types and the website real browser provider/theme tests pass with one byte-verified Bloom copy at both the root and Services importer. The root catalog remains pinned to 6.2.1; consumers explicitly choose one supported line. Versions 6.3.x, 6.4.x and 7.1.0/7.1.1 remain excluded. VERIFIED 7.13.1: admit the shared dialog accessibility release. Consumers on this line must resolve the same Bloom instance as Services to share surface and overlay contexts. VERIFIED 7.14.0: the additive outlined Stepper release is covered by Services build, types and tests against the published package. The maintenance release retains the existing 11.1.0 source and supported peer lines. VERIFIED 7.15.0: additive Button focus, hover and keyboard events; Services types and all 113 test suites pass against the official package, with unchanged 11.1.0 source and existing peer lines preserved. VERIFIED 7.16.1: Accordion and rating styling plus bounded Dialog scrolling and initial focus; Services types and all 1040 tests pass against the official package. The maintenance source remains unchanged from 11.1.0, and packed exports are verified. VERIFIED 7.17.0: additive Carousel arrow recipes and Search field styling, dialog focus restoration and Accordion DOM filtering; Services types and all 1040 tests pass against the official package with unchanged maintenance source. VERIFIED 7.18.0 AND 7.19.0: additive rich selection labels, flat overlays, Search icon geometry and Carousel footer/loop/insets; Services types and all 1040 tests pass separately against each official package. The maintenance source remains unchanged from 11.1.0. VERIFIED 7.20.0: additive viewport observation, opt-in Meter/RatingBar reveal and Dialog minimum side gutter; Services types and all 1040 tests pass against the official package. The maintenance source remains unchanged from 11.1.0. VERIFIED 7.21.0: Services 11.1.8 maintenance types and all 1040 tests pass against the additive Dialog/BottomSheet backdrop and transition release candidate; Mercaria verifies one Bloom runtime, responsive sheets, Arabic, reduced motion, and focus restoration. VERIFIED 7.22.0: Services 11.1.9 types and all 1040 tests pass against the rich RadioGroup composition and public Collapsible release, including the shared Accordion implementation. Mercaria verifies frequency selection, closed-panel focus and portaled Select dismissal with one Bloom runtime. Maintenance runtime source remains unchanged from 11.1.0.
